item.title: Rallying Cry – November 14, 2026
item.description: Mexico, the US, Costa Rica, and Jamaica are teaming up for a historic 2031 Women’s World Cup bid, while China pledges to power all new demand with clean energy, and Alaska just elected its first Democratic governor in years.
